nodes.name: application.yml
nodes.summary: Spring Boot runtime configuration for the chart backend: Postgres and Redis connections, Flyway migrations, JWT and CORS, TradingView datafeed flags, and demo tick-cache cadence.
nodes.languageNotes: YAML with Spring Boot relaxed binding and ${ENV:default} placeholders for Docker Compose Postgres and Redis.

nodes.name: messages.properties
nodes.summary: Default English API error messages keyed to ErrorCodes.MSG_* for validation, not-found, server, unauthorized, bad-credentials, and bad-request.

nodes.name: messages_ja.properties
nodes.summary: Japanese API error message overrides loaded when Accept-Language starts with ja, covering the same ErrorCodes keys as the English bundle.
